entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Chang Fat-kwei was a Chinese Nationalist general who fought against northern warlords, the Imperial Japanese Army and Chinese Communist forces in his military career. He served as commander-in-chief of the 8th Army Group and commander-in-chief of the National Revolutionary Army ground force before retiring in Hong Kong in 1949.
